name: Hachinin no Mazokko
source:
Akio Yokosuka is a teacher who works at a prestigious girls' school. He dreams of a loving relationship with a masochist girl, but all that appears before him are uncaring, self-centered girls.

One day, though, after collapsing from too much stress, Akio wakes up with a new ability. He can now see through girls with hidden "masochism''.

However, this ability only lasts for 30 days. Over the course of this month, he will find the best masochist partner he can imagine and make his lifelong dream come true.
translation:
横须贺明夫是一所名门女子学校的教师。他梦想与有受虐倾向的女孩建立亲密关系，但出现在他面前的女孩全都冷漠又以自我为中心。

然而有一天，明夫因压力过大倒下，醒来后获得了新的能力。他现在能够看穿女孩隐藏的“受虐倾向”。

不过，这项能力只能持续30天。在这一个月里，他要找到自己能想象到的最佳受虐搭档，实现毕生梦想。
